findings.evidence: Concordance.lean:423–461 defines restriction for arbitrary G on M × ℝ and arbitrary a < b. Restriction.lean:135 already defines smooth metric restriction, Isometry/Restriction.lean:81 proves scalarCurvature_restrictOpenTangentSpace, and PositiveScalarCurvature/Basic.lean documents PSC restriction.
findings.fix: Move the restriction construction and inner-product lemmas to Riemannian/Restriction.lean, scalar-curvature preservation to Riemannian/Isometry/Restriction.lean, and PSC preservation to PositiveScalarCurvature/Basic.lean; move their differential helper with the construction.
findings.issue: The RestrictIcc section contains no concordance-specific hypotheses: restrictIcc, restrictIcc_inner, restrictIcc_inner_congr, scalarCurvature_restrictIcc, and HasPositiveScalarCurvature.restrictIcc belong in earlier infrastructure modules.

summary: The interval restriction API is general metric infrastructure placed in the concordance module, forcing unrelated users to import concordance theory.
